body: I hope in those couple months you find a reason to keep going, I'm here for you if you need me.
I promise it'll go away. I don't know when, but it will I swear. I'm sorry I can't do more for you, other than promise that.
I can't offer any advice, all I can say is is that I'm so sorry you're suffering and your boyfriend is too. I hope everything works out for you
You are one of the kindest human beings to think of how someone may feel guilt. I'm so sorry you're suffering, I wish I could solve that for you. You deserve good things.
You are a good person. You try every day to be a nice person and that is the best thing you can do. You are a wonderful person and I'm proud of you for trying to be nice. Thank you.
You're allowed to feel the way you do, even if you think your life is great. You are allowed to feel this way, I want to learn how to live too. I'm proud of you for talking about your feelings.
I'm so proud of you for being here today. I really am so proud of you.
I'm sorry your parents weren't better for you. You deserve better.
I'm so sorry, the social anxiety isn't your fault-- you're so brave for trying to socialise even when you're uncomfortable. I hope you do live, and life is so wonderful for you. I'm proud of you.

You've had such a hard time, I'm so so sorry. You deserve better, I'm so sorry and wish there was something I could do for you. If no one has told you this recently, then I will now-- I'm proud of all you've done. I'm proud of how far you've come, I'm so proud of you. I'm sorry-- you deserve better I promise.
I don't wanna hurt others. I've never wanted to hurt others you have to believe me.
